notes.title: Don't buy me
notes.content:
This project is not an active project. I will definitely return with a bigger and better engine in the future.

Although I am thankful for everyone single one that bought and played the game, I urge anyone to rather check out the next project until I come back to this. 

If you would like to be a part of the next project, please contact me on discord directly at 'paganza'.

notes.title: Dev continues 07 Jan 2021
notes.content:
I'd like to thank everyone for still sticking it out. Development has had some setbacks the last year or so. However with a new job which enables me more time to work on CF I hope to introduce quests and subterranean maps, along with the all new power mechanics soon. 

There is also alot of work to be done regarding multiplayer and this may be broken on some maps. 

If you'd like to stay up to date with the latest features you can subscribe to the experimental branch, go to Properties->Betas->Select experimetal to opt in.

notes.title: Multiplayer and More
notes.content:
I'm just going to slide this in here...

After months of development I'm happy to bring you co-op Multiplayer (only 2 players at the moment) and the start of an additional factory.

Please note that previous saved games will not work with this update.

notes.title: Physics Update
notes.content:
[b]Christmas brings many presents and this update brings physics, storage control and sound effects.
[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33904043/39c37b52abfd589f4149c71759d0f44d2171e3d4.png[/img]

Using physics we can now launch items over conveyors and buildings or up mountains, drop items onto conveyors below, stack the conveyors with ridiculous amounts of items etc.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33904043/9dcfccafee628bcee1d793823578bef1801a856f.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33904043/5e899d6b2596f84241f93bb67b2a7771232a41cf.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33904043/f3cf8367001f5684665f6347e4702e1c96f2c4c5.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33904043/7552a95a7d60603c290b4e3f8571032fae4cc65b.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33904043/63a19f7fdec51bbdb3ea3b7c19678105e9cc68a3.png[/img]

Storages can now be set to release items and to which directions.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33904043/b207e0a52f5f6c2ea073bf64c648edb01aff2d2c.png[/img]

And the first sound effects for buildings when they are active have been implemented.

notes.title: Transportation Upgrade Update
notes.content:
Hi cubics,

[list]
[*] This first official update brings better looking conveyors and lifts:
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33904043/8059a91b42900108fa70ceb155aee4b9551d63b3.png[/img]


[list]
[*] Lifts can also now stack:
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33904043/73c2026bfc2afb15c794fbfa88518789fe43c211.png[/img]


The old elevators will still load for existing save games however they are not buildable anymore.

[list]
[*] Also new, the distributor to split or merge lanes and the filter conveyor, use these together to filter a mixed conveyor lane:
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33904043/71b1cc36b7792d130a218b29a7e46b24913315bb.png[/img]

For now these are available without research.

Just some basic keyboard commands:
WASD - Move camera
E - Copy building at mouse cursor OR Clear building for construction
C - Clear item from conveyor
DEL - Destroy building
CTRL /ALT - Show building/conveyor overlays

Still working on the UI so you will see alot of continuing changes there.

Please note that this is still Early Access which means there will be updates, new features and improvements as well as bugs and rebalancing.
